<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Obtain Safe Passage to Conquer the State of Guo</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
<span style="font-family: inherit;">Duke Xian (<span><span lang="zh-CN">晋献公</span></span>,
died 651 B.C.) of Jin, in 658 B.C., wanted to conquer the smaller
states of Yu and Guo, but could not while these remained allied to
each other. Following the advice of his officer Xun Xi (<span><span lang="zh-CN">荀息</span></span>),
Duke Xian sent beautiful women to the Duke of Guo, and a beautiful
young man to the Duke of Yu, with special instructions to distract
them from government affairs. Meanwhile, men were sent to stir up
trouble on Guo's northern border. As was expected, officials in Guo
blamed Duke Xian for this new trouble on the northern border. Duke
Xian then feigned insult by sending Xun Xi to the State of Yu to
request safe passage for avenging the insult. Xun Xi arrived in the
State of Yu bearing gifts of Jade and horses to formally request
passage. The Duke of Yu, now under the influence of his new lover,
immediately agreed -- even over the protests of his own advisors. The
Duke of Jin then distracted the Duke of Yu with a hunting trip while
having his general, who had been faking illness, conquer Yu while the
duke and his best men were away [12].</span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Obtain
Safe Passage to Conquer the State of Guo</span></i></span> is
associated with the 47th hexagram, <i>Lake over Water</i>. Here the
Lake has been emptied -- drained or dried up, suggesting a state of
exhaustion. Communication between the second and fifth yang lines
marks an alliance where the resources of two states have been
combined to prevent such exhaustion [1], [28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

LIST 24:</b></span></span></span></p>

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="font-size: x-large;"><b><span style="color: #333333;">Sample Sentences 24:</span></b></span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section76" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">把手套带给我，可以吗？它们在柜子里。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Can you bring me the
	gloves? They are in the closet.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">2)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">那个被子你应该自己洗，</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="zh-CN">
	</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">对洗衣机来说</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;它太大了。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不能那么早下班，我有很多试卷要改。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I cannot get off work
	that early, I have many tests to grade.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">4) </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">他假借父母之名给我老师打电话。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">5)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">道路两边有很多不同的植物。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我去小店买东西，你需要什么吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">一卷胶带。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) I. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的腰带丢了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">II.
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">你记不记得，最后一次看到它是什</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;么时候？</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;"></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;</span></span></p><div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp; III.
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">是的，我记得。我把它卷起来，然</span></span>
    </span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;后放进柜子里了。</span></span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">8)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们需要多少张火车票？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">四张。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">9) </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">他们好像不会停止对他的讨伐。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">10)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这里怎么一团糟？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">11)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你画得这一副画是什么？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">是乌龟。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">12)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个羊肝好吃。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">1</span></span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">3</span></span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span></span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
	</span></span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">蟑螂喜欢潮湿的地方。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<br />

</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
